contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Reach me for problems, ideas or a personal optimization.

pitch.title: Advanced optimization, tailored to you
pitch.body: This program applies settings that are safe for everyone. If you want me to look at your PC, games and network with you and set up something personal, write to me.
pitch.p1: Setup tuned to your hardware and games
pitch.p2: Review focused on ping, FPS and input delay
pitch.p3: Remote, step by step and reversible

about.title: About
about.noDownload: This program does not download or run code from the internet.
about.bgHint: When off, a static background is used.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Windows' own repair and settings tools.
tools.oneDriveConfirm: OneDrive is removed from this computer. This cannot be undone from this program; your cloud files stay but syncing stops.

sfc.name: System file check
sfc.desc: Finds and repairs damaged Windows system files (SFC).

dism.name: DISM repair
dism.desc: Repairs the Windows component store, for errors SFC cannot fix.

dns_flush.name: Flush DNS cache
dns_flush.desc: Clears stale DNS entries; helps when some sites do not open.

winsock_reset.name: Reset Winsock
winsock_reset.desc: Resets the network stack to defaults. Restart afterwards.

perf_counters.name: Repair performance counters
perf_counters.desc: Rebuilds the counters Task Manager relies on.

one_drive_uninstall.name: Uninstall OneDrive
one_drive_uninstall.desc: Removes the OneDrive app from this computer.

defrag_gui.name: Optimize drives
defrag_gui.desc: Opens the Windows defragment and TRIM tool.

perf_options_gui.name: Performance options
perf_options_gui.desc: Opens the visual effects settings window.

mouse_cpl.name: Mouse settings
mouse_cpl.desc: Opens the Windows mouse properties window.

keyboard_cpl.name: Keyboard settings
keyboard_cpl.desc: Opens the Windows keyboard properties window.
